ingredients.heading: For the masala base:
ingredients.items:
2 tbsp Cumin Seeds
1 white onion
1 tbsp garlic puree
3cm fresh ginger
1 tsp garlic coriander powder
1 tsp ground coriander
1/2 tsp ginger powder
1 tsp garam masala
1/4 tsp turmeric
1/2 tsp red chili powder
Salt (to taste)
Water (splash)

ingredients.heading: For the samosa filling:
ingredients.items:
4 potatoes
100g peas
Handful of fresh oriander
320g (1 roll) puff pastry
1 egg (optional)

steps:
1. Cut the potatoes into equal cubes and boil for around 8-10 minutes, then set aside
2. In a pan, fry off cumin seeds and add in finely chopped onion and cook until soft, mix in garlic puree, fresh ginger and the spices listed above
3. Give it all a good mix and add some water if need be, then add in the frozen peas and cooked potato, add a handful of fresh coriander on top and leave to cool
4. Once the mixture has cooled, lay out a puff pastry sheet and cover with the samosa mix - make sure its layered as evenly as possible
5. Roll up the puff pastry until the edges are smooth, then wrap in cling film and leave firm in the fridge for around 30 minutes to make it easy to cut
6. Cut into even slices, lightly egg wash (optional - can leave this out if you don’t eat eggs) and bake in the oven for 12-15 minutes at 180 degrees celsius (fan) until golden
7. Serve with green chutney
title: Punjabi Samosa Swirls
tips: If you don't eat eggs, feel free to skip that step! Alternatively, you can lightly wash with milk before placing in the oven!
description: A modern twist on a Punjabi classic. Ridiculously more-ish and much lighter than traditional Punjabi samosas!
